label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled param reaches HTML output sink. Although '-->' is stripped, this allows attackers to inject content that breaks comment boundaries (e.g., 'test--><script>' becomes '<!-- test<script> -->' where the comment closes prematurely and script executes). Resolved sink value is '<!-- ' + param.replace('-->', '') + ' -->' containing attacker-controlled data.

evidence.note: User input from request.getParameter flows through replace('-->') and into response.getWriter().println HTML output
